name: Daifugō
summary: Japanese shedding climbing game where players race to empty their hand to become Grand Millionaire.
rules_text: Played with 52 cards, 3+ players. All cards are dealt. Before play, Daihinmin gives 2 strongest cards to Daifugō and Hinmin gives 1 to Fugō; they return equal junk cards. Tricks: leader plays 1-4 cards of same rank. Next player must play same count of higher rank or pass; passing does not block later play. 2 is highest, 3 lowest. If all pass, last player to play leads. A player who empties hand is out. Others continue to determine order. After round, seats reorder clockwise by title, Daifugō left of dealer, who is Daihinmin. Next round repeats with taxation.
